title: Shiraishi An — Where They Couldn't Go〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. There was a crack in the wall, and then I started hearing someone singing. That was when I saw her. But I think it was just an illusion created by my feelings.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I totally froze up! I was so startled! Seriously, she's still causing all this trouble even when she's gone!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I thought if I brought my partner along, she'd show up again to meet you... But I guess it just doesn't work that way.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Honestly, Dad said she wanted to meet you! And here we are, and she's not here!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, don't give me that look!
I'm fine! Honest!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That time, she patted my head like she always used to and...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's the one we used to sing together...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (We didn't get a chance to actually talk... But, I think she understood what I wanted to tell her.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Remember what I said, Aunt Nagi. I'm gonna catch up to you soon.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: She still hasn't reached her ceiling...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I don't want to put Kohane on a pedestal like I did that time.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I don't wanna sit by while she flies higher and higher... I don't wanna feel that pain anymore...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (So, I have to face up to this.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I have to take a hard look at myself, face my problems, and Kohane...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thanks for coming along, Kohane!
I got the push I needed because you did.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Really?
Then, I'm glad I came.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Now, let's head back.
You were gonna practice on your own after this, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm having Luka and MEIKO help me with something. Would you like to join us, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Are you sure?
Then, if you don't mind...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Of course!
Oh, we're supposed to meet at MEIKO's—

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then, let's race to see who gets there first! Ready...? Go!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wait, what...?!
An, that's not fair! You can't just give yourself a head start!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha! Try to catch me, Kohane!
